or change: Current TS 38.213 Clause 23 mentions “A UE can be provided, by physCellIdList, a physical cell identity of a second cell and an ARFCN by ARFCN-ValueNR for SS/PBCH block receptions on the second cell.” However, the higher layer parameter for NES cell is using validSIB26-Cells in OD-SIB1-Config. Summary of change: Replace physCellIdList by validSIB26-Cells. Consequence if not approved: NES cell ID cannot be found in physCellIdList; therefore, the UE behavior cannot be properly defined. Agreement Adopt the following TP for Clause 23 in TS 38.213. Agreement Adopt the following TP#2 for clause 8.1 of TS 38.213. Reason for change: The rule for mapping SS/PBCH block indexes to PRACH occasions for SIB1 request is not described. Summary of change: Add the source of ssb-PositionsInBurst for on-demand SIB1 request for mapping rule. Consequence if not approved: UE can not determine the mapping rule for on-demand SIB1 request. Agreement Adopt the following TP#5 for clause 23 of TS 38.213:

{"chunk_id":"R1-2508174-029","collection":"ran1_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":["Ericsson"],"tdocNumber":"R1-2508174","title":"List of RAN1 agreements for Rel-19 NES WI"},"point_id":"14443327032289117639"}
Agreement: The proposed TP for TS38.211, Clause 4.4.2, captured in FL Proposal 3-1 in Section “Issue 3” in R1-2507962, is endorsed. < Rapporteur’s note: TP referenced in above agreement is captured below> FL Proposal 3-1 Adopt the following text proposal for TS 38.211: Reason of change: Some parameters of UL-WUS configuration for SIB1 request in TS 38.331 are not correctly captured in TS 38.211. Summary of change: Update parameters of TS 38.211 according to the parameters defined in the latest CR for TS 38.331. Consequence if not approved: gNB and UE may have inconsistent understanding on PRACH generation for SIB1 request and PDCCH demodulation for obtaining SIB1. Agreement: The proposed TP for TS38.213, Clause 8.1, captured in FL Proposal 3-2 in Section “Issue 3” in R1-2507962, is endorsed. < Rapporteur’s note: TP referenced in above agreement is captured below> FL Proposal 3-2 Adopt the following text proposal for clause 8.1 of TS 38.213: Reason of change: The association period for mapping SS/PBCH block indexes to PRACH occasions for SIB1 request is not described. Summary of change: Add the source of ssb-PositionsInBurst for on-demand SIB1 request. Consequence if not approved: UE can not determine the association period for on-demand SIB1 request. Agreement: The proposed TP for TS38.211, Clause 5.3.2, captured in FL Proposal 4-1 in Section “Issue 4” in R1-2507962, is endorsed. < Rapporteur’s note: TP referenced in above agreement is captured below> FL Proposal 4-1 Adopt the following text proposal for clause 5.3.2 of TS 38.211: Reason of change: In current 38.211 spec, Δf is specified as the PRACH SCS (i.e., msg1-SubcarrierSpacing) rather than the UL BWP SCS, which may result in incorrect PRACH signal generation. Summary of change: Adopt the UL BWP SCS (ul-SubCarrierSpacing) for Δf. Consequence if not approved: Incorrect PRACH signal generation. Conclusion: There is no concern in RAN1 on RAN2 LS R1-2506714. No response is needed. Agreement: The proposed TP for TS38.211, Clause 5.3.2, captured in FL Proposal 2-4 in Section “Issue 2” in R1-2507963, is endorsed. < Rapporteur’s note: TP referenced in above agreement is captured below> FL Proposal 2-4 On how to determine for UL WUS baseband signal generation in 38.211 5.3.2, RAN1 to adopt the following TP1 to 38.211 5.3.2: Reason of change: The parameters is not provided by OD-SIB1-config. Summary of change: Determine the parameters by parameter that has been included in OD-SIB1-config, i.e., ul-SubCarrierSpacing. Consequence if not approved: UE does not know how to generate the OFDM baseband signal generation for PRACH for SIB1 request. Agreement: The proposed TP for TS38.213, Clause 23, captured in FL Proposal 3-4 in Section “Issue 3” in R1-2507963, is endorsed. < Rapporteur’s note: TP referenced in above agreement is captured below> FL Proposal 3-4 Adopt the following text proposal for clause 23 of TS 38.213: Reason of change: Some parameter names are not correct in 38.213. Summary of change: Correct OD-SIB related parameter in TS 38.213. Consequence if not approved: Wrong parameters to be referred.
